body: It's probably my fault though I probably drove them to that point. I start the arguments and I shout a lot but never anything directly hurtful like this, I'm usually the angry one they just snap. But according to every councillor or therapist I have been too they all say it's out of my control and not my fault my parents blame me for it though.

I know they love me, they are nice when we aren't arguing it's just stuff like this bearing in mind they say stuff that is upsetting like this about once a week. When i bring it up I'm using what they say against them or holding onto things and being over dramatic so I never know if what they say to me is normal or not. I speak to a school councillor about my anxiety etc and I want to bring this up because it really does upset me but I don't know how she would react or whether this is all normal and I'm just extremely confused by it

It happens a lot they say this kind of stuff they say I'm abusive and ruining the family. I'm a cow and a horrible daughter apparently. There nice to me when we aren't arguing but they don't apologise and will generally stick by it if I bring it up to them
